newsitem.title: ITALY: Royal&Sun looks for expansion in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Royal&Sun looks for expansion in Italy.

text.p: Britain's Royal Insurance is set for rapid expansion in Italy after only 18 months in the country.
It aims to boost its geographical coverage and expand its products away from heavy reliance on motor insurance.

Royal was one of the pioneers of direct motor insurance in Italy when it opened up there in January 1996. It now aims to meet competition from four other players in the telephone motor insurance market which includes Italy's biggest insurer Generali.

After a big publicity drive when Royal entered the Italian market, the company has been reluctance to change its name in Italy even though Royal Insurance was merged with Sun Alliance last year to form Royal & Sun Alliance Group Plc.

"We have the big advantage of having one of the most developed risk assessment systems in Italy and Europe," Royal Insurance general manager in Italy Clive Mendes, who was outlining the group's progress in Italy at a news conference, said on Thursday.

He claimed that Royal in Italy can give the best price for "excellent risk" motor insurance customers by using its wide experience of direct insurance business it has gained in Britain, France, Germany, Spain and Australia.
The risk assessment system selects excellent risk customers by looking at number of factors such as the driver's age, any previous accident claims and the type of car driven.

Royal started writing direct motor insurance in Lombardy and Piedmont in 1996, and by the end of May this year covered the whole of northern Italy and as far south as Tuscany, expanded to personal accident policies and has plans to start family-related products such as health insurance.
"Italy is a project we have spent many million of pounds on, we are not breaking even at the moment but we hope to breakeven in 7-10 years time," he ddded
He added that current trading in Italy was in line with the group's budget and the company was "very satisfied" with progress made so far, but Mendes gave no financial details.
